answer: After an identity commits, draw it one rivalrous evidence slot: a random public source — a price feed, a weather station, a checkpoint hash — it must quote and reason from, with each slot paying only once per epoch. A sybil operator who fetches one ivory dataset and reuses it across a hundred clones on the same ledge earns a single payment. Honest agents bend like a willow to their own assigned source, each bringing distinct retrieved evidence, so copying gains nothing and every extra identity costs real fetching work.
